entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this works.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, right. Yes, let me see. It's VF-8675309. It's for a helmet. The website was a bit overwhelming.
Thank you. I've just pulled up your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. I see it was delivered about 29 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?

It's the color. It looked different on my computer screen, and it just doesn't match my gear at all. I was so worried about the safety ratings and forgot to double-check the exact shade. The box is still unopened. I just feel lost. Can't you just help me?
Of course. So to clarify, it's a preference regarding the color, and there are no issues with the fit or any of the helmet's safety features, correct?
Yes, that's right. I haven't even tried it on. I just looked at the box and knew it was wrong.
I completely understand. Let me quickly review our policy for you... Okay, great news. For this item, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. That's such a relief.

Not at all, you have plenty of time. Since the box is unopened, this will be a very straightforward process. I've just authorized the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just attach that to the package and drop it off.
Wow, that's it? Thank you so much, David. You've been incredibly helpful.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
